objective: Deliver the staged, project-agnostic governance execution-efficiency program GEE V1: R1 canonical foundation (contracts, project-agnostic core, project adapter, Definition-of-Ready activation), R2 Context Compiler, R3 Delta Engine, R4 Evidence Graph and reuse, R5 routing, cost and repair containment, R6 recovery, index and usage, R7 benchmarks, hostile validation and program closure. Each stage is implemented only by its own revision, under its own sealed execution contract; declaring a stage here never authorizes its execution.
strategicPurpose: Prevent under-defined work units from being activated, prevent project-specific hardcoding in the reusable core, and keep every program stage bounded by its own execution authority so no revision can implement a later stage.

prerequisites.statement: GATE13 must be COMPLETE_CONFIRMED after independent audit

stateTransitionRules: R1 stage = canonical foundation: contracts, project-agnostic core, project adapter, Definition-of-Ready
R4 stage = Evidence Graph and reuse
R5 stage = routing, cost and repair containment
R6 stage = recovery, index and usage
R7 stage = benchmarks, hostile validation and program closure
R2_COMPLETE -> R3_AUTHORIZED -> R3_COMPLETE -> R4_AUTHORIZED -> R4_COMPLETE -> R5_AUTHORIZED -> R5_COMPLETE -> R6_AUTHORIZED -> R6_COMPLETE -> R7_AUTHORIZED -> R7_COMPLETE
invalidationDeclarations: A stage declared at strategic level is NOT authorized for execution: execution authority exists only where that revision has its own sealed execution contract.
Each revision's execution authority is limited to its own stage; no revision authorizes a later stage.
A revision whose execution contract declares a verdict this strategic authority does not know is invalid.
notes: R0001 authorized by PROJECT_OWNER mission GOVERNANCE_EXECUTION_EFFICIENCY_V1 R1 after GATE13 COMPLETE_CONFIRMED.
